## What this category is

Link to the matching rung on the learning ladder. Say what the category is good
for and what it adds to verify.

## How to judge a tool in this category

The questions that matter for this category (data, grounding, citations, cost
model, where it runs). Include at least one diagram (a fenced `mermaid` block).

## Options

Group by type. For every entry: what it is, the answers to the judging questions
("Not confirmed in official docs" where the docs are silent), whether a free
option exists, the official source link, and the date checked. At least two
options, including a free or open-source one where available. No prices.

## How to choose

A short decision flow based on data class, environment, and need, not on brand.

## Try it: compare two options

A short hands-on exercise that compares two options on the same sources, using
the verification habits from the guide.
